relationship_to_game_rules: Patch strategy overrides tune coaching priors only. They do not define game-rule timing, augment stages, choice pretriggers, base economy math, or leveling thresholds.

economy_management_overrides.patch_scope: S17.7 tempo/meta bias; replace or supersede this patch file when patch balance changes.
economy_management_overrides.relationship_to_base: Overrides only patch tempo bias. Base economy compounding, interest math, and leveling thresholds still apply.

tempo_bias.summary: Current S17 is treated as a transition/tempo-oriented season where open loss-streak lines are riskier than in seasons with obvious overpowered lock-HP units.
tempo_bias.single_open_risk: Higher than seasons where one overpowered carry package can stabilize from low board value.
tempo_bias.preferred_default: Stable economy plus real strongest-board transition unless live_state proves the user can preserve a streak or safely greed.

early_leveling_bias.level_4: Level only when current units plus components make a real combat board, or when a confirmed tempo/HP-protection/economy source justifies the spend.
do_not_level_when: the board does not have real pairs/two-star pressure
components do not fit current holders
there is no extra economy source and leveling would break important interest without likely wins
early_leveling_bias.recovery_policy: If early level 4 fails to streak, stop compounding the mistake: skip level 5, sell low-value holds, and recover normal economy when possible.

contested_meta_policy.summary: This season is assumed to be contested/involuted enough that waiting too long for a perfect uncontested 4-5 level-8 line is often unsafe.

fast_8_timing.default_4_cost_line: 4-2 level 8 after augment is the normal 4-cost timing when economy permits.
fast_8_timing.4_1_contest: 4-1 level 8 can be correct to contest cards when rich or when opponents are poor, but it roughly costs an extra level click plus one interest round.
fast_8_timing.4_5_delay: 4-5 level 8 is rare; require no serious contest and enough HP.

host_model_policy: When user target and big-data line conflict, do not force-pivot immediately. Explain evidence: live board fit, item fit, augment fit, HP/economy, and what future hit would justify staying.
Because this S17 bias is less loss-streak friendly, be cautious about recommending open-sell or long greeding unless HP/economy/stabilizer facts support it.

event_policy.patch_reason: S17.7 has special choice windows and tempo-sensitive midgame checkpoints; these are review priors only and must not override live HP, confirmed choices, board quality, item fit, user target, or contest facts.
